## MUS-D-0027

**What the mandate keeps from the fixture, and what it does not**

decision · 2026-08-19

The tool keeps the name and arguments the milestone 1 stub carried, and the clause in the context file is the fixture's wording. Three things differ and the entry names all three: two optional arguments, a sentence for when the tool is absent, and the transport — the fixture was stdio, where the tool is always there.

**Four of StrucGu's five roles are implemented, and the repository adopts five modules**

## MUS-D-0029

**A milestone is read by agents that did not build it**

decision · 2026-08-20

Governs: [MUS-M-0002](milestones.md#mus-m-0002)

Owner-set. Three reviewers spawned fresh per milestone — this milestone's done-when, the shipped claims, and workflow.md's own gates — each given the milestone, the branch and the contract and never the builder's report. They change nothing; findings are dispositioned in the pull request.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rationale | [decisions.md#a-milestone-is-read-by-agents-that-did-not-build-it](../decisions.md#a-milestone-is-read-by-agents-that-did-not-build-it) |
| Lifted from | LinkCtrl's phase loop, with three deliberate differences |

---

## MUS-D-0030

**Stopping takes a reason from a table**

decision · 2026-08-20

A milestone accepted is one iteration. The default is to start the next one in the same turn, and stopping requires a row from a closed table — with the excuses that are not reasons written down beside it, context running long chief among them.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rationale | [decisions.md#stopping-takes-a-reason-from-a-table](../decisions.md#stopping-takes-a-reason-from-a-table) |
| Lifted from | LinkCtrl's phase loop, plus two rows of this repository's own |

---

## MUS-D-0031

**Pull requests are stacked**

decision · 2026-08-20

Costs: [MUS-D-0029](#mus-d-0029)

Each branch is cut from the one before it and its pull request targets that predecessor rather than main, so a finding fixed in the base reaches everything above it by a rebase instead of being fixed once per branch. A milestone that does not decompose ships as one pull request.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rationale | [decisions.md#pull-requests-are-stacked](../decisions.md#pull-requests-are-stacked) |

---

## MUS-D-0032

**The audit is not a gate until someone asks**

decision · 2026-08-20

Costs: [MUS-F-0001](findings.md#mus-f-0001)

Exit status is zero whenever the audit ran; findings are output. StrucGu's argument, adopted: a check that fails on day one in a repository with required status checks is made non-required within the hour, and a dead gate is worse than no gate because it looks like coverage.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rationale | [decisions.md#the-audit-is-not-a-gate-until-someone-asks](../decisions.md#the-audit-is-not-a-gate-until-someone-asks) |

---

## MUS-D-0033

**The audit runs in CI, against a real catalog**

decision · 2026-08-20

Corrects: [MUS-D-0032](#mus-d-0032)

The owner's call. CI checks out StrucGu at a pinned ref and the tests read MUSTUR_STRUCGU, so the conformance assertions run on every push rather than once on one machine. Vendoring a copy was the alternative and was rejected: a stale copy proves conformance to nothing.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rationale | [decisions.md#the-audit-runs-in-ci-against-a-real-catalog](../decisions.md#the-audit-runs-in-ci-against-a-real-catalog) |

---

## MUS-D-0034

**The record roles are mapped at the export**

decision · 2026-08-20

Costs: [MUS-F-0008](findings.md#mus-f-0008)

The owner's call. decision_log, findings and investigations point at records/ rather than at the prose files, so the audit reads the records Mustur owns, as the scope row promises. triage_doc stays at workflow.md, which is a rule and not a record.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rationale | [decisions.md#the-record-roles-are-mapped-at-the-export](../decisions.md#the-record-roles-are-mapped-at-the-export) |

## MUS-D-0035

**The store holds more than it did**

decision · 2026-08-20

Corrects: [MUS-D-0023](#mus-d-0023)

Corrects MUS-D-0023's enumeration, which is stale rather than wrong in its reasoning. A count written into an append-only file is a claim with an expiry date; the export's own index is where a reader should look.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rationale | [decisions.md#the-store-holds-more-than-it-did](../decisions.md#the-store-holds-more-than-it-did) |

## MUS-D-0036

**Nothing vendors StrucGu**

decision · 2026-08-20

Refined by: [MUS-D-0033](#mus-d-0033)

The audit reads its modules from a StrucGu checkout and refuses to guess. A pinned copy of somebody else's specification goes stale silently, and a conformance harness run against a stale copy proves conformance to nothing. Recorded after the entry that refines it, because identifiers are assigned in the order records are written and never reordered.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Rationale | [decisions.md#nothing-vendors-strucgu](../decisions.md#nothing-vendors-strucgu) |
